in_sanskrit.name: Athansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Treasure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Athansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Athansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Atman’ meaning ‘self’ and ‘Shri’ meaning ‘goddess of wealth’. The name Athansh signifies God's treasure, symbolizing wealth in the form of wisdom and knowledge. This name is believed to be a blessing from the gods for a prosperous and enlightened life.
